blinding_guess.why: The robot_description param is declared (xacro of sia20d.xacro), the checked-in sia20d.urdf matches the xacro macro link-for-link and joint-for-joint, and controller_joint_names matches the URDF joints. The one irregularity is that load_sia20d.launch runs $(find xacro)/xacro.py while package.xml declares no build or run dependency on xacro; whether that counts as a defect in this element cannot be told from the snapshot alone.

notes: ROS 1 (indigo) support package containing only launch, config, urdf and mesh files; no compiled code. The param is declared once, relative, as name="robot_description" in launch/load_sia20d.launch:2; it resolves to /robot_description when that file is launched in the global namespace (it is included unchanged by test_sia20d.launch:2 and robot_state_visualize_sia20d.launch:25; test/launch_test.xml includes it under ns groups for file checks only). The declares entry copies the name verbatim as written (no leading slash). The value is the xacro expansion of urdf/sia20d.xacro, which instantiates macro motoman_sia20d with prefix="" from urdf/sia20d_macro.xacro: 9 links (base_link, link_s, link_l, link_e, link_u, link_r, link_b, link_t, tool0), 7 revolute joints (joint_s, joint_l, joint_e, joint_u, joint_r, joint_b, joint_t) and fixed joint link_t-tool0. frame is null because the param carries a whole kinematic tree (root link ${prefix}base_link, tip ${prefix}tool0) rather than one frame for the element. units is null: the URDF values (e.g. joint origins 0.41, limits 3.1415, velocity 2.2689) follow URDF/SI conventions but neither the code nor a definition states units. msg_type and definition_id are null because a parameter has no .msg/.srv/.action/.idl definition. QoS null (ROS 1). The package also loads param controller_joint_names from config/joint_names_sia20d.yaml (not a packet element). A static urdf/sia20d.urdf (marked autogenerated from sia20d.xacro) is also shipped; it is consumed as robot_description by the separate motoman_sia20d_moveit_config package via textfile=, which is outside this package. Launch files also include other packages' launch/config files ($(find motoman_driver)/launch/robot_interface_streaming_$(arg controller).launch, $(find motoman_driver)/launch/robot_state_$(arg controller).launch, $(find industrial_robot_client)/config/robot_state_visualize.rviz); these are files, not interface elements, and are not listed in references. package.xml run_depends: motoman_driver, robot_state_publisher, rviz, joint_state_publisher; package.xml exports a deprecation notice (to be removed in Kinetic, content moved to motoman_sia_support in Jade).
